BY virtue of the powers vested in me Order under Section 38 (a) of the Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby direct the Acquiring Oﬃ cer or any other oﬃ cer authorized by him referred to in Paragraph 1 of the Schedule to take possession of the land speciﬁ ed in the corresponding entry in Paragraph 2 of that Schedule. Ministry of Agriculture Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, No. 1200/6,Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.24th January, 2025.

01. Lot No. 01 – Mulhalkelewatta – Extent:1.1210 HectaresNorth: Rambukpotha Kandura and Mulhalkelewatta claimed by Land Reforms Commission; East: Mulhalkelewatta claimed by Land Reforms Commission; South: Mulhalkelewatta claimed by Land Reforms Commission and Lot No. 02; West: Mulhalkelewatta claimed by Land Reforms Commission, Lot No. 02 and Rambukpotha Kandura.
